git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: ITEM 1 closes the 2-source detection gap with a narrowed cross-file predicate at WARN severity (additive, doesn't weaken existing FAIL guard). ITEM 2 closes the deletion option for the dead code, removing the 5 dead reads while preserving the optional-styling branch.

diff_stats.justification_for_overage: ITEM 1 requires +34 lines because it introduces two new helper functions (_mk_dup_cross_file_warn for distinct WARN message + _is_cross_file_pair for predicate), restructures the loop body from list-comprehension to explicit branched loop with continue (to prevent triple-duplicate double-counting), and adds explanatory comments documenting the additive WARN semantics and cross-file-only narrowing rationale. The minimum-possible single-line implementation would have been ~25 lines but would have collapsed message construction inline (less readable), inlined the predicate (less testable), and omitted the explanatory comments (the spec hints + ban-list constraints make documentation valuable for future maintainers). The two new helper functions follow the existing module's helper-function decomposition style (cf. _mk_dup, _mk_orphan, _mk_hollow already present). ITEM 2 is exactly minimum-diff (5-for-5 substitution, no helper introduction).
